mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced cost of capital for corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in federal funds rate above 0.5% signals monetary tightening, increasing real discount rates and reducing equity valuations, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 9.0% and rise in employment (PAYEMS) above 130,000 thousand signal strengthening labor market conditions, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS > 130,000 and UNRATE < 9.0% fails to predict positive returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession housing recovery regime, new housing starts (HOUST) exceeding 600,000 units signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity, increasing corporate revenue expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 600.0 in post-recession recovery regime, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment rate (UNRATE > 8.0%) suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced economic activity.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 8.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output capacity and earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 90.0, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in CPI index (CPIAUCSL > 220.0) and stable low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) indicates persistent inflation without policy response, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of CPIAUCSL > 220.0 and FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing slowdown regime, industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 (index 2017=100) signals reduced output capacity, suppressing corporate earnings and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0 in manufacturing slowdown regime, or Rank IC remains negative over any 2-year rolling window.
